items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: So his doctor traveled with him. Dr. Sheff told us,

ctx.x: His -- he had a bad congestion problem. He used to cough hard all the -- for years, years and years. He coughed hard all the time. But he used to do some of the damndest things. He'd eat a big meal over there in Italy, and he'd get on a great big fan and go get in a chair and lay back and go to sleep, and I used to look and wonder how he'd do things.
So his doctor traveled with him. Dr. Sheff told us,
don't try to emulate this guy, you know, because you'd die probably tomorrow, he said. He took a laxative every night for 40 years.
